lyrics:
[Intro: aching pad chords, vinyl hiss]

[Section A: shuffling breakbeat enters, sub bass]

[Vocal Chops: sighing female syllables, pitched]
Oh-way, oh
Oh-way, oh

[Section B: pad melody, breakbeat fuller, rave piano stab]

[Break: pad alone, a distant crowd]

[Vocal Chops: the same sigh, slower]
Oh-way

[Section C: full breakbeat, melody an octave up]

[Outro: pad fading, birds at dawn, hiss]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 130 BPM, 4/4 breakbeat, F minor. Quick underfoot and slow in feeling: bittersweet and nostalgic.

VOICE: No sung lyric. A woman's voice is cut into two or three sighing syllables and pitched to follow the chords.

INSTRUMENTS: Warm, slightly detuned pad chords carrying the melody, a shuffling sampled breakbeat with a soft snare, a deep sub bass, a single 1990s-style piano stab, vinyl hiss, a far-off crowd, dawn birdsong.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, pads. 0:20 Section A, breakbeat. 0:46 Vocal chops. 1:10 Section B, melody. 1:50 Break, crowd. 2:08 Chops, slower. 2:20 Section C, octave up. 3:00 Outro, birds and hiss, ends 3:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Modern UK electronic with 1990s rave colours: soft, hazy and wide, drums crisp but quiet, pads in front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The breakbeat entering under the pads at 0:20.

STATION FIT: Sunday, 2 a.m. The deepest hour of the set: an instrumental for people who are awake, remembering.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Wistful, moving, far away, dawn.
